packages.name: pi-knowledge
packages.purpose: local-first hybrid repository retrieval with local embeddings

packages.name: pi-lsp-extension
packages.purpose: LSP semantics, diagnostics, structural search and Tree-sitter fallback

packages.name: pi-code-tool
packages.purpose: sandboxed programmatic tool composition without model round-trips

packages.name: pi-lean-edit
packages.purpose: range edits backed by prior-read snapshots to reduce edit-token overhead

packages.name: pi-sub-agent
packages.purpose: bounded scout/reviewer roles with statically assigned models

packages.name: pi-tree-sitter
packages.purpose: pre-write syntax guard; useful but edit-hook compatibility with pi-lean-edit is not yet qualified

notes.bundled: Installed automatically with pi-offline-engine (package.json dependencies) and loaded through its pi manifest. Do not pi-install them separately: that registers a second copy of the same tools.
notes.environment: Engine settings already default to the profile values, and pi-offline-engine sets PI_KNOWLEDGE_SEARCH_PROFILE=low_token unless you chose one. Set PI_KNOWLEDGE_OFFLINE=1 only after pi-knowledge has downloaded its local embedding model (index one real repository while online); before that it blocks the download.
